title: Helicopters vanish into a pixelating mountain door east of Coyame

tellings.quote: The mountainside starts to pixelate. It dissolves from 3D to 2D [music] to nothing as the helicopters slip through and vanish from one world into another.

plain: In 2004, about five miles east of the town of Coyame in Mexico, helicopters are said to have flown straight into a mountainside that opened like a door: the rock began to pixelate, dissolving from three dimensions to two and then to nothing, as the aircraft slipped through and vanished "from one world into another." Michels narrates this scene from a book called Sentinels of Ether, citing a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, and tells it as a sign that some craft may pass between our world and somewhere else.
